twin.name: Beamline twin
twin.title: Beamline twin: operate an XAS beamline in your browser
twin.description: Run a working X-ray absorption beamline: monochromator, mirrors, ion chambers and a fluorescence detector. Scan, fit the EXAFS, train on faults and calibrate from your own data.
twin.ogAlt: Beamline twin card: an XAS beamline from the source to the detectors

spectrum.name: Read the spectrum
spectrum.title: Read the spectrum: which atoms make each part of an EXAFS spectrum
spectrum.description: Split an EXAFS spectrum into its shells of neighbours and see them around the absorbing atom in 3D: each shell's wave in chi(k), its peak in |chi(R)| and how far that peak sits from the true distance.
spectrum.ogAlt: Beamline twin card: an XAS beamline from the source to the detectors

elements.name: Elements
elements.title: X-ray absorption edges by element
elements.description: K, L and M edge energies, jump ratios and fluorescence yields for every element from hydrogen to californium, with links to plan an XAS sample.
elements.ogAlt: Elements card: X-ray absorption edge energies for hydrogen to californium

tools.name: Calculators
tools.title: XAS beamline calculators: gases, mirrors, self absorption, dose
tools.description: Four quick calculators from the beamline twin: ion chamber gas fills, the harmonic rejection mirror angle, fluorescence self absorption and X-ray dose rate, from tabulated cross sections.
tools.ogAlt: Calculators card: ion chamber gas, mirror angle, self absorption and dose

pages.name: Ion chamber gas
pages.title: Ion chamber gas calculator for XAS
pages.description: Choose the gas fill for an I0 or It ion chamber at any X-ray energy and chamber length: the absorbed fraction of He, N2, Ar and Kr mixes from tabulated cross sections.

pages.name: Harmonic rejection mirror
pages.title: Harmonic rejection mirror angle calculator
pages.description: Find the mirror angle that keeps the fundamental and rejects the third harmonic for Si, Ni, Rh and Pt coatings at any energy, with the cutoff energy and both reflectivities.

pages.name: Self absorption
pages.title: Fluorescence self absorption estimator for XAS
pages.description: Estimate how much self absorption shrinks the white line and EXAFS in a fluorescence measurement, for any formula, density, thickness and detector angle.

pages.name: X-ray dose
pages.title: X-ray dose rate calculator for XAS samples
pages.description: Dose rate in gray per second for any sample, flux, energy and beam size, with the absorbed power, the flux density and the time to reach typical damage doses.

instructors.name: For instructors
instructors.title: Teach XAS with the beamline twin: class links and results
instructors.description: Run an XAS class on the beamline twin: share one task and seed with a link, let students find the hidden fault, then load their result files into a class table. No accounts, nothing uploaded.
instructors.ogAlt: Instructors card: class links, hidden faults and a class results table

pages.name: Overview
pages.title: XAS Lab: X-ray absorption spectroscopy in your browser
pages.description: Pick any chemical formula, find its X-ray absorption edges, plan a sample, compare spectra and follow the quantum workflow behind XAS. Runs in your browser.
pages.ogAlt: XAS Lab overview card with an absorption edge curve

pages.name: Sample
pages.title: Choose a sample and absorption edge
pages.description: Enter any chemical formula and density, then pick the absorbing element and its edge. Uses tabulated X-ray data for every element from hydrogen to californium.
pages.ogAlt: Sample card: choose a formula, an absorbing element and an edge

pages.name: XAS beamline
pages.title: XAS beamline simulator
pages.description: Scan the photon energy across an absorption edge, set the sample thickness and see how many photons reach the detector, using tabulated cross sections.
pages.ogAlt: Beamline card: X-ray source, sample and detector with an absorption curve

pages.name: Spectra studio
pages.title: Spectra studio: compare and fit XAS spectra
pages.description: Save curves, import your own CSV or JSON spectra, normalise them, find the edge, and score a model against data with an energy shift and similarity metrics.
pages.ogAlt: Spectra studio card with overlaid absorption spectra

pages.name: Electronic structure
pages.title: Electronic structure behind an absorption edge
pages.description: See which core to valence transitions shape an absorption edge, and size an active space like the one used in recent quantum computing studies of XAS.
pages.ogAlt: Electronic structure card showing a core electron excited to an empty level

pages.name: Quantum dynamics
pages.title: Quantum dynamics: from time signal to spectrum
pages.description: Kick a ground state with a dipole operator, evolve it in time and Fourier transform the signal into a spectrum. Load your own Hamiltonian of up to six qubits.
pages.ogAlt: Quantum dynamics card with a time signal turning into spectral peaks

pages.name: Experiments
pages.title: Ready-made XAS experiments
pages.description: Open guided experiments in one click, from lithium charge balance to scans across an absorption edge, and save or share your settings as a link or a file.
pages.ogAlt: Experiments card listing guided XAS experiments

pages.name: Methods & validation
pages.title: Methods, data sources and validation
pages.description: The equations, data sources, sanity checks and arXiv papers behind the lab, and the claims these teaching models cannot support. Read this before citing results.
pages.ogAlt: Methods card listing equations, data sources and checks
